name: digital-bell
description: Digital Bell - Automated School Bell System
author: Nagji Yadav Sakodara <9982151938>

scripts.clean-build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['installer', 'release'].forEach(d => fs.rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true})); console.log('Clean completed.');"
scripts.verify-dependencies: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['index.js','build/icon.ico','build/tray.png','raw_web/index.html','raw_web/USER_MANUAL_HINDI.html','raw_web/assets/school_bell_Tan-D0KlyVNl.wav','raw_web/assets/Long-bIIZeSmH.wav'].forEach(f => { if(!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error(f + ' missing'); }); console.log('✓ All runtime dependencies and assets verified!');"
